area.hero.h1: Heating and cooling repair in West Town, Chicago
area.hero.lede: Boilers and radiators, furnaces, central air and ductless systems, for West Town two- and three-flats, workers' cottages, converted lofts and storefronts. Family-owned since 1952, with the owner, Rob, still on the calls.
area.form.title: Book HVAC service in West Town
area.services.heading: Every heating and cooling service we offer in West Town
area.who.copy: City & Suburban is run from 1225 N Cleaver St, half a block north of Division in West Town itself. Rob, the owner, still runs the calls and does the diagnosis on the jobs that need it.
area.reviews.1.quote: Hello. When I had a problem with my boiler I called the first name I saw in the book. Because I didn’t do much research on City and Suburban I was afraid of paying a high price for service. I was incorrect. Rob Koehler showed up on time and fixed my boiler for a reasonable charge. I now had heat. Victory!
area.reviews.2.quote: Great company. I called on a Sunday night because my furnace wasn’t working. The repair person was here first thing on Monday morning. Absolutely fantastic. He was friendly and knowledgeable and got my furnace running very quickly. He then reviewed various options with me for the future. It was very easy to send my payment via Zelle. Could not have gone better.
area.reviews.3.quote: Outstanding work! AC/Furnace needed replacement. Two other companies would not even quote the job due to the roof location of the compressor. C&S H&C came and provided a quote on very short notice. Most technically sound solution for our preference and price was competitive vs other quotes. Installation was scheduled right away after quote acceptance. Everything was installed within the day and so far working good.
area.reviews.4.quote: Our A/C stopped working during the recent heat wave. Other companies didn't return our messages, but City & Suburban answered right away and were professional and communicative throughout. Rob was able to get to our place within a few hours, and he quickly diagnosed and fixed our A/C unit. He was practical and professional, and we would definitely call again.
area.scope.heading: The same repair costs differently in a two-flat, a cottage and a loft
area.scope.1.why: Many two- and three-flats still heat with a boiler and radiators. A boiler repair is a different job from a furnace one.
area.scope.2.why: In two-flats and condo conversions, one boiler can serve every unit, so the owners decide on repairs together.
area.scope.3.why: Radiator-heated flats have no ducts for central air, so cooling usually means ductless mini-splits.
area.scope.4.why: Furnaces and boilers sit in low basements; condensers go on garage roofs or in gangways off the alley.
area.scope.5.why: Converted lofts and shops on Chicago Ave, Division and Grand often run rooftop units, so roof access sets the work.
area.scope.6.why: The biggest swing of all. Where the unit has years left, we say so.

area.buildings.heading: What heats and cools your West Town building
area.buildings.1.title: Two- or three-flat
area.buildings.1.body: A shared boiler and radiators, or a furnace per unit after conversion. Condensers off the alley.
area.buildings.2.title: Workers' cottage
area.buildings.2.body: Small forced-air furnaces in low basements. Ductwork is tight; ductless is often the cleaner way to cool.
area.buildings.3.title: Converted warehouse
area.buildings.3.body: Split systems or rooftop units added in the conversion. Exposed ceilings decide where ducts go.
area.buildings.4.title: Storefront or restaurant
area.buildings.4.body: Rooftop units, kitchen exhaust and make-up air. Scheduled around opening hours.

area.faq.heading: West Town HVAC, answered
area.faq.1.q: Does the boiler in my two-flat need replacing, or can it be repaired?
area.faq.1.a: Often it can be repaired. We diagnose first, and where the boiler has years left, we say so. Replacement is quoted only when the repair stops making sense.
area.faq.2.q: How far is your shop from West Town?
area.faq.3.q: Can you cool a radiator-heated two-flat without ductwork?
area.faq.4.q: Does HVAC repair in Chicago need a permit?
area.cta.body: Have the make of your boiler, furnace or condenser to hand, and tell us what it's doing. In a loft or storefront, mention how we get onto the roof.

extras.districts.4.hvac: HVAC here: rooftop units and splits in lofts, forced air in newer condos.
extras.faq.2.a: We're in it. The shop is at 1225 N Cleaver St, half a block north of Division, and Rob runs the calls from there.
extras.faq.3.a: Usually, yes. Radiator-heated flats have no ducts for central air, so cooling means ductless mini-splits, with the condenser on a garage roof or in the gangway.
extras.faq.4.a: No. Chicago doesn't require a permit to repair, diagnose or maintain heating and cooling. Permits cover installs and construction, so a company's permit count says little about its repair work.
extras.faq.5.a: Monday to Friday, 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Saturday, 6:00 AM to 3:30 PM. Call (773) 238-3838.
